column1: # Post-processing variable table for ICON: SPICE-compatible monthly post files (one variable per file).
# pkp006 (PG KICS cycle-2026 initial tests): only the four deliverables PMSL
# name       post file name <name>_ts.nc (SPICE / COSMO style)
# icon_name  variable name in the ICON output ("-" for derived quantities)
# hout_inc   output interval of the stream
# operation  output_nml operation of the stream: - | mean | max | min
# role       deliver: final post file | intermediate: input of a derived file
#            derived:<recipe>: computed from other post files (recipe sp = wind speed from U/V)
